text_to_image_prompt: Create one standalone photorealistic female character portrait, 1086 x 1448 pixels, vertical 3:4. Strict frontal eye-level ID-photo composition with the entire head and upper torso visible, centered head and direct gaze, level shoulders, no head tilt or rotation. Balanced left and right cheek widths, cheekbone heights and jaw taper; level eyes and aligned nose, philtrum, lips and chin. Relaxed neutral expression. Solid pure white background, bright soft balanced frontal studio illumination, natural skin pores and fine hair detail, restrained makeup, gentle contrast and coherent warm neutral photographic grading. No scene, text, watermark, border, collage, extra person or visible hands. Long polished dark brown hair, warm medium skin, brown eyes, dark defined brows and full nude-pink lips. Apricot yellow sleeveless scoop-neck dress with small gold dangling earrings. Both cheek surfaces are clean, with no stray hair or dark hairlike shadow crossing the skin.
original_prompt: Edit this portrait with ONE precise local cleanup only. On the IMAGE RIGHT cheek (woman's left cheek), remove the thin dark hairlike streak / stray hair shadow on the facial skin, including any dark curved strand near the cheekbone and outer cheek. Restore clean uninterrupted natural skin texture and the same warm tan skin color in that small area. No hair or thin black shadows crossing either cheek. Keep all facial features, face contour, eyes, expression, skin tone, hairstyle outside the skin, gold earrings, yellow dress, pose, lighting and composition as close to the source as possible. Keep straight-on eye-level view, single person on pure white. Exact output 1086 x 1448 pixels. No UI, text, watermark or border.
